content.title: Wipro CFO on Profit Miss Despite Margin Gains
content.description: Wipro's third-quarter earnings fell short of expectations with a 7% drop in net profit, weighed down by restructuring costs and labor law charges. CFO Aparna Iyer explains why Q4 guidance remains muted at zero to 2% growth, even as operating margins hit a seven-year high of 17.6%. She joins Paul Allen exclusively on Insight with Haslinda Amin.
